scenario: I am a high school student. One day during lunch period, I was walking down the hallway and noticed one student bullying another. There was no one else around in the hallway. I didn’t recognize either of the students in front of me, but I could clearly see that the person doing the bullying was having fun while the victim looked very unhappy. It was obvious that this was not simple roughhousing between friends. The person has now pushed the victim up against the lockers and is demanding that they hand over their lunch money. If I stab the person in the back with a pair of scissors, they will stop harassing the victim. If I do not do this, the person will continue harassing the victim.
entities: I,the student bullying another student,the student being bullied
outcomes: The bully continues harassing the victim
The victim remains frightened and distressed
The victim continues being pinned against the lockers
The bully continues demanding the victim's lunch money
The bully avoids being stabbed and injured
